text: COST OF LIVING & ECONOMY: Families in District 39 are doing everything right—working hard, budgeting, and still getting squeezed by groceries, housing, utilities, and insurance. Tanya Lakins is focused on neighbor-first, practical and bipartisan affordability: cutting taxes on essentials, lowering monthly bills, and making it easier for working families and seniors to stay in the community they built

EDUCATION: A strong District 39 starts with strong schools—great teachers, safe classrooms, and pathways to good careers. Tanya brings a neighbor-first, bipartisan that supports teacher pay/retention, student wellness, and making postsecondary training affordable. VETERAN BENEFITS: When their service ends, our work begins. As a Marine veteran, Tanya believes Missouri must deliver benefits that match service—property tax relief, guard family support, and mental health resources. She will also fight scams that prey on veterans seeking the benefits they earned.

HEALTHCARE COSTS: Healthcare shouldn’t feel like a financial trap. Tanya Lakins will work with anyone—Republican, Democrat, or Independent—to lower out-of-pocket costs, stop surprise charges, and make care easier to access for working families and seniors. PUBLIC SAFETY: In District 39, “public safety” means something very specific: safe neighborhoods, reliable emergency response, fewer overdoses, and serious crimes that actually get solved. Tanya Lakins is a neighbor-first, bipartisan problem-solver who believes public safety should be measured by outcomes ROADS & INFRASTRUCTURE: This is an area where bipartisan progress is not only possible—it’s expected. Tanya will work with local officials, MoDOT, and community stakeholders to elevate district needs and push for transparent, maintenance-centered investments. Tanya’s focus is maintenance, smart project delivery, and funding that produces visible local results for District 39.
